decisions.reason: The inertial measurement module builds directly on the firm's modular sensor platform and in-house firmware expertise, and its move to a page of its own signals growing commitment.
The industrial AC input module extends the firm's core industrial module line, was highlighted at launch, and is consistently presented on a page of its own, so it fits existing know-how well.
The solid state relay module is a low-cost addition that uses established relay and module design competences, and the firm can readily interpret customer feedback to refine it.
The RGB LED control module draws on long-standing LED driver and module knowledge, and it is too new for the firm to have learned enough to justify dropping it.
The remote access service builds on the firm's own wallbox software and its growing charging business, so in-house development capacity makes improving it more likely than dropping it.
